tasks.label: Docker: Start Environment
tasks.command: docker compose up -d

tasks.label: Docker: Stop Environment
tasks.command: docker compose down

tasks.label: Docker: Enter Container Shell
tasks.command: docker compose exec dev bash

tasks.label: Docker: Rebuild Image
tasks.command: docker compose build --no-cache

tasks.label: Docker: View Container Logs
tasks.command: docker compose logs -f dev

tasks.label: Build: Everything
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel build --config=clang-libstdcxx13 //...'

tasks.label: Build: Apache Module (libmod_pagespeed.so)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel build --config=clang-libstdcxx13 //:libmod_pagespeed.so'

tasks.label: Build: Apache Module (Debug)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel build --config=clang-libstdcxx13 -c dbg //:libmod_pagespeed.so'

tasks.label: Build: Envoy Filter
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel build --config=clang-libstdcxx13 --jobs=4 //pagespeed/envoy:envoy_pagespeed'

tasks.label: Build: Everything Except Envoy
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel build --config=clang-libstdcxx13 -- //... -//pagespeed/envoy/...'

tasks.label: Build: Clean
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel clean'

tasks.label: Build: Clean Expunge
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel clean --expunge'

tasks.label: Test: All Unit Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached //test/pagespeed/... -- -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache_apr'

tasks.label: Test: Kernel Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 //test/pagespeed/kernel/...'

tasks.label: Test: System Library Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached //test/pagespeed/system/...'

tasks.label: Test: Rewriter Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 //test/net/instaweb/rewriter:rewriter'

tasks.label: Test: Cache Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached //test/pagespeed/kernel/cache/...'

tasks.label: Test: Image Tests
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 //test/pagespeed/kernel/image/...'

tasks.label: Test: With Debug Output (Streamed)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --config=clang-libstdcxx13 --test_output=streamed --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached //test/pagespeed/... -- -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache_apr'

tasks.label: System Test: Run All
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && ./test/system/run_system_tests.sh'

tasks.label: System Test: Build Module Only
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && ./test/system/run_system_tests.sh --build-only'

tasks.label: System Test: Run Only (Skip Build)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && ./test/system/run_system_tests.sh --skip-build'

tasks.label: System Test: Keep Apache Running After
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && ./test/system/run_system_tests.sh --keep-running'

tasks.label: System Test: Clean State Run
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo killall -9 apache2 2>/dev/null; sudo rm -rf /var/cache/mod_pagespeed/*; cd /src && ./test/system/run_system_tests.sh'

tasks.label: Test: With AddressSanitizer (ASAN)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --keep_going --config=clang-asan --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached --test_output=errors //test/pagespeed/... -- -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache_apr'

tasks.label: Test: With ThreadSanitizer (TSAN)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'cd /src && bazel test --keep_going --config=clang-tsan --test_env=REDIS_PORT=6379 --test_env=REDIS_HOST=redis --test_env=MEMCACHED_PORT=11211 --test_env=MEMCACHED_HOST=memcached --test_output=errors //test/pagespeed/... -- -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache -//test/pagespeed/apache:apache_apr'

tasks.label: Apache: Start
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo apache2ctl start'

tasks.label: Apache: Stop
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo apache2ctl stop'

tasks.label: Apache: Restart
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo apache2ctl restart'

tasks.label: Apache: Check Status
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'ps aux | grep apache2 | grep -v grep; echo "---"; curl -sI http://localhost/ 2>/dev/null | head -10 || echo "Apache not responding"'

tasks.label: Apache: View Error Log
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo tail -50 /var/log/apache2/error.log'

tasks.label: Apache: View Error Log (Follow)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo tail -f /var/log/apache2/error.log'

tasks.label: Apache: Clear PageSpeed Cache
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'sudo rm -rf /var/cache/mod_pagespeed/*'

tasks.label: Apache: Test mod_pagespeed Working
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'curl -sI http://localhost/mod_pagespeed_example/ | grep -i pagespeed || echo "mod_pagespeed not responding"'

tasks.label: Util: Format C++ File (clang-format)
tasks.command: clang-format -i ${file}

tasks.label: Util: Check Services (Redis/Memcached)
tasks.command: docker compose exec -T dev bash -c 'echo "Redis:"; redis-cli -h redis ping; echo "Memcached:"; echo stats | nc memcached 11211 | head -5'
